page_title: DoaCam — Free 3D AI Companions You Can Video Call

sources.entry: DoaCam - AI video companion with a 3D avatar that sees you through your camera, talks in real time, and remembers every conversation. Runs in browser.

summary.name: DoaCam
summary.one_liner: DoaCam is a browser-based service where you video call 3D AI companions that see you through your camera, talk back in real time, and remember past conversations.
use_cases: rehearse a difficult or job interview conversation
talk through your day out loud
summary.what_it_does: The page describes 3D AI companions you call live in the browser, with the companion seeing you through your camera and responding by voice in real time. It says companions remember every conversation across calls. The page lists 16 named companions grouped by purpose: general company, language practice, interactive stories, rehearsing hard conversations, games and jokes, tarot and mystery readings, and an 18+ section. It does not describe the underlying technology, data handling, or how memory works in detail.
notable: 3D avatars you video call live in the browser
16 companions with different purposes, including language tutoring and interview rehearsal
Remembers conversations across calls, per the page
caveats: Includes an 18+ section with flirtatious companions
Page does not state limits on free usage or whether any paid tier exists
